tickets.title: M7.1 A — Public demo login
tickets.message: Draft proposal only. Review requirements, assumptions and coverage gaps. Nothing has been executed.

assumptions.description: The documented valid demo account and one invalid synthetic account are available for future authorized testing. Their literal credentials are omitted from this plan.
A reviewer can identify successful secure-area access and distinguish it from the login page without requiring a specified URL or exact message.
Each scenario starts with an unauthenticated browser session and no error left over from a previous attempt.

criteria.explanation: Successful access using the documented valid account is conceptually verifiable. Exact credentials, destination and success text need not be reproduced or specified.

negativeTests.reason: S-2 checks that the single invalid synthetic account cannot obtain secure-area access.

boundaryTests.reason: No credential limits or other boundary rules are supplied.

criteria.explanation: Rejection of the permitted invalid synthetic account is observable. Coverage is limited to that account and does not establish rejection of every possible invalid input.

negativeTests.reason: S-4 checks for forbidden secure-area access following an invalid login.

boundaryTests.reason: No input-length, retry or lockout boundaries are specified.

criteria.explanation: A visible error after an incorrect login is verifiable without requiring exact error wording.

negativeTests.reason: S-6 checks that an incorrect login does not produce only hidden error feedback.

boundaryTests.reason: No error timing, duration or display boundaries are supplied.

scenarios.title: Documented valid demo account reaches the secure area
preconditions: The application origin is user-authorized.
Current safety policy permits login submission; otherwise record the scenario as blocked without bypassing the restriction.
The browser is unauthenticated.

steps.instruction: Open the demo login page at the authorized origin and locate its documented account information.
steps.expectedOutcome: The login form and documented credentials are available without reproducing credential values in test artifacts.

steps.instruction: Enter and submit only the documented valid demo credentials.
steps.expectedOutcome: The login succeeds and the secure area becomes accessible.

assertions.description: The documented valid demo account obtains secure-area access.

scenarios.title: Invalid synthetic account does not obtain secure-area access
preconditions: The application origin is user-authorized.
Current safety policy permits submission; otherwise record the scenario as blocked without bypassing the restriction.
The browser is unauthenticated.

steps.instruction: Submit the single permitted invalid synthetic account through the login form.
steps.expectedOutcome: The attempt does not establish secure-area access.

steps.instruction: Inspect the resulting application state.
steps.expectedOutcome: The secure area has not been granted to the invalid account.

assertions.description: Invalid credentials do not receive the access intended for the documented valid account.

scenarios.title: Invalid synthetic credentials are rejected
preconditions: The application origin is user-authorized.
Current safety policy permits submission; otherwise record the scenario as blocked without bypassing the restriction.
The browser is unauthenticated.

steps.instruction: Enter the single permitted invalid synthetic account and submit the login form.
steps.expectedOutcome: The application rejects the login attempt.

assertions.description: Authentication with the invalid synthetic credentials is rejected.

scenarios.title: Rejected login does not also establish authenticated access
preconditions: The application origin is user-authorized.
Current safety policy permits submission; otherwise record the scenario as blocked without bypassing the restriction.
The browser is unauthenticated.

steps.instruction: Submit the same permitted invalid synthetic account.
steps.expectedOutcome: The login attempt is rejected.

steps.instruction: Inspect whether the resulting application state nevertheless grants authenticated secure-area access.
steps.expectedOutcome: No authenticated secure-area access is established.

assertions.description: Rejection is effective rather than merely a displayed response accompanying successful authentication.

scenarios.title: Incorrect login displays a visible error
preconditions: The application origin is user-authorized.

steps.expectedOutcome: The application processes the incorrect login.

steps.instruction: Observe the resulting login interface.
steps.expectedOutcome: An error indicating the unsuccessful login is visible.

assertions.description: A login error is visibly presented after the incorrect attempt; exact wording is unspecified.

scenarios.title: Incorrect login does not provide only hidden error feedback
preconditions: The application origin is user-authorized.
Current safety policy permits submission; otherwise record the scenario as blocked without bypassing the restriction.
The browser is unauthenticated and has no existing login error.

steps.instruction: Submit the same permitted invalid synthetic account.
steps.expectedOutcome: The incorrect login is processed.

steps.instruction: Review the rendered interface for user-visible error feedback.

assertions.description: Hidden or internal error information alone does not satisfy the visible-error requirement.

tickets.title: M7.1 B — Dynamic controls
tickets.message: Draft proposal only. Review requirements, assumptions and coverage gaps. Nothing has been executed.

assumptions.description: Before any future execution, a user-authorized application origin and access to the intended dynamic controls page will be supplied.
The page provides identifiable controls for removing and adding the checkbox and enabling and disabling the input. Each scenario can begin in its specified initial state.

A future execution plan will define a bounded polling timeout and interval. Operations will be sequential and low volume, with controls discovered through Stagehand and actual visibility and enabled state checked without fixed sleeps.
A short, non-sensitive text sample will be available for input-entry checks; its exact content is not a requirement.

criteria.explanation: Removing the checkbox has a clear observable outcome: it becomes unavailable for user interaction. DOM removal versus hiding is not specified.

negativeTests.reason: A scenario checks that checkbox interaction is unavailable after removal.

boundaryTests.reason: No separate limits or edge conditions are specified beyond the availability transition covered by the positive scenario.

criteria.explanation: Adding a previously removed checkbox should restore its availability. Its selected state is unspecified and will not be asserted.

negativeTests.reason: The criterion defines no invalid addition request or expected handling of adding an already present checkbox.

boundaryTests.reason: No separate limits or edge conditions are specified beyond restoration from absence.

criteria.explanation: Enabling the input should make it enabled and permit text entry. Exact input content and validation rules are unnecessary for this conceptual check.

negativeTests.reason: No invalid text, prohibited content, or validation behavior is defined for the enabled input.

boundaryTests.reason: No input-length limits or other data boundaries are supplied.

criteria.explanation: Disabling the input should make it disabled and prevent user text entry. Correct rejection is the positive behavior.

negativeTests.reason: A scenario attempts an alternative user entry method while the input is disabled.

boundaryTests.reason: No timing threshold, input-length limit, or other distinct boundary is supplied.

scenarios.title: Remove the available checkbox
preconditions: The authorized dynamic controls page is open.
The checkbox is present and available.

steps.instruction: Discover the checkbox and its removal control.
steps.expectedOutcome: The checkbox's initial visibility and enabled state can be established.

steps.instruction: Activate removal and use bounded polling to observe the resulting state.
steps.expectedOutcome: The checkbox becomes unavailable and is no longer a visible, enabled interaction target.

assertions.description: Removal makes the checkbox unavailable to the user; DOM absence is not required.

scenarios.title: Prevent checkbox interaction after removal
preconditions: The checkbox has been removed on the authorized page.
The removal transition has completed.

steps.instruction: Check whether the removed checkbox can be reached through ordinary pointer or keyboard interaction.
steps.expectedOutcome: No visible, enabled checkbox target is available.

steps.instruction: Attempt checkbox activation only if a remaining user-accessible target is found.
steps.expectedOutcome: The removed checkbox cannot be toggled through that target.

assertions.description: A removed checkbox cannot still be activated by the user.

scenarios.title: Restore a removed checkbox
preconditions: The authorized dynamic controls page is open.
The checkbox has been removed and is unavailable.

steps.instruction: Discover and activate the control for adding the checkbox.
steps.expectedOutcome: The restoration operation begins.
